verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only conventional analytics: performance monitoring, benchmarking against similar businesses, and recovery analytics. It also documents automated Smart Retries and an MCP server that lets external agents call the Stripe API. None of this is described as AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced inside the product, and the MCP server belongs to a different story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
